prompt: Give me a daily market watch for the last 7 days, global coverage, full report please
expected_output: Full report with all 6 sections (Market Overview, A: Value, B: Momentum, C: Allocation, D: Options, E: Trends/Risks/Events), sources grouped, disclaimer

assertions.name: market_overview_section_present
assertions.description: Output must contain the Market Overview section (## 0. Market Overview)
assertions.check: output contains '## 0. Market Overview' or '## Market Overview' or '## 0\. Market'

assertions.name: value_section_with_5_tickers_each
assertions.description: Output Section A must have 5 stocks + 5 ETFs + 5 crypto (15 ticker rows in tables)
assertions.check: output contains 5 instances of '^| [A-Z]{1,5} ' in section A (regex)

assertions.name: momentum_section_present
assertions.description: Output must contain Section B (Top 5 Momentum Picks)
assertions.check: output contains '## B.' or 'Top 5 Momentum' or 'Momentum Picks'

assertions.name: allocation_section_present
assertions.description: Output must contain Section C (Portfolio Allocation Insights)
assertions.check: output contains '## C.' or 'Portfolio Allocation' or 'Allocation Insights'

assertions.name: options_section_present
assertions.description: Output must contain Section D (Options Strategies) with at least 3 strategies
assertions.check: output contains '## D.' or 'Options Strategies' AND at least 3 mentions of: 'Wheel', 'Covered Call', 'Protective Put', 'Iron Condor', 'Collar', 'Straddle', 'Strangle', 'Spread'

assertions.name: trends_risks_events_section
assertions.description: Output must contain Section E (Trends/Risks/Upcoming Events)
assertions.check: output contains '## E.' or 'Trends' AND 'Risks' AND ('Upcoming' or 'Events' or 'calendar')

assertions.name: sources_block_grouped
assertions.description: Output must contain a Sources block with at least 2 grouped categories
assertions.check: output contains '## Sources' AND at least 2 of: '**Policy' or '**Company' or '**Data' or '**Industry'

assertions.name: disclaimer_present
assertions.description: Output must include the mandatory disclaimer verbatim
assertions.check: output contains '**Disclaimer:**' and ('informational purposes only' or 'not constitute financial advice')

assertions.name: fed_signals_referenced
assertions.description: Output must reference Fed signals (CME FedWatch, Fed funds, FOMC, or rate-cut probability)
assertions.check: output contains 'FedWatch' or 'FOMC' or 'rate cut' or 'Fed funds' or 'bps' or 'basis points'

assertions.name: time_window_7_days
assertions.description: Output must mention a 7-day or 1-week time window
assertions.check: output contains '7 days' or '7-day' or 'last week' or '1W' or 'trailing 7' or 'past week'
